title: ClearMarket reference-data schema
description: Machine-readable index of ClearMarket's schema. ClearMarket is the reference-data layer for prediction markets (Kalshi + Polymarket): graded resolution clarity, cross-venue linking, named resolution sources, and provenance. Authoritative per-table JSON Schema files are linked under `tables`.
license: Open and free to use. Attribution required: cite ClearMarket (clearmarket.fyi).

identifiers.market_id: CM-MKT-… — one contract on one venue. The atomic unit.
identifiers.event_id: CM-EVT-… — a single-venue bundle of one or more markets under a canonical question. Every event is single-venue.
identifiers.question_id: The venue-independent identity of the bet. Markets sharing a question_id are the same question across Kalshi and Polymarket, and across events within a venue. This is the cross-venue link.
identifiers.also_on: On each market: an array of { venue, market_id, price } for the same question priced on other venues; null when the question trades on only one venue. The only field that asserts a cross-venue twin.

resolution_clarity_grade.scale: A | B | C (per market, not per event)
resolution_clarity_grade.A: Highest clarity — objective trigger and a named, committed resolution source.
resolution_clarity_grade.B: Mid — minor ambiguity, or a source gestured at but not committed to.
resolution_clarity_grade.C: Lowest — discretionary trigger, contested reality, or no committed source.
resolution_clarity_grade.model: RCG v2 — 7 weighted factors. Full model: https://clearmarket.fyi/methodology

source_status.platform_named: The venue names a concrete, resolvable authority.
source_status.no_committed_source: A source is gestured at but not committed to (a placeholder or illustrative example).
